text:
Monzo's savings rates depend on which Monzo plan you have. These figures come from Monzo's own pages. Some of those pages are a few months old, so check the app for today's rates.

**Instant Access Savings Pot (variable rate)**
- Free plan: 2.80% AER. Extra: 3.15%. Perks, Plus and Premium: 3.55%. Max and Max Family: 3.80%.
- The higher rates apply on balances up to £1,000,000.
- Interest is paid on the 1st of the month.
- You get instant withdrawals, no minimum deposit and up to 20 different Savings Pots.

**Other options**
- **Cash ISA Pot:** Instant Access Cash ISA rates match the Instant Access Savings rates for each plan, for example 2.80% AER (variable) on the free plan.
- **Select Access Savings Pot:** 3.45% AER (variable) on lower plans. Perks and Max customers get 3.70%. This pot needs a £500 minimum to open.
- **Fixed Rate Savings Pot:** 5.25% AER (fixed) for a 3-year term, with other terms also available. That is a fixed rate, so your money is tied up for the term.

Variable rates can change at any time. The paid plans also cost a monthly fee, so a higher rate only pays off if you have enough savings to cover it. If you tell me roughly how much you plan to save, I can work out whether upgrading would be worthwhile.
